_doc: Where UAE stores write a product's barcode in their own URLs (catalog_match.url_gtin). Each store lists its hosts (a host or any subdomain of it) and regular expressions for the PAGE url ('page') and the IMAGE url ('image'); each pattern has one named group 'gtin' and is searched in the URL's path only (no query string), case-insensitive. Only stores whose own product id or image file name IS the barcode are listed: Carrefour's media ids (cdn.mafrservices.com/.../50736324968478/...) and Lulu's '/p/4504613' are store-internal numbers that can pass a check digit by chance, so they are not. A number matched here still has to be a valid GTIN-8/12/13/14 (check digit), globally unique (not an in-store 02x/04x/2xx code) and a consumer unit (indicator 0) with a GS1 prefix that numbers trade items (no coupon, refund or demo range): catalog_match.url_gtin.plausible. Foreign stores (Qatar, Kuwait, Saudi) are not listed: their pack may carry another barcode. What a URL says is evidence only (url_gtin): it never lifts a tier and never auto-publishes.

stores.example: /mafuae/en/utensils-gadgets/delcasa-stainless-steel-ice-cream-scoop-with-trp-handle-dc2426/p/6294016314273 (a 12-14 digit product id only; the short ids are internal)
